about: Pennsylvania county and city grant programs, entered by hand from each program's own page. Not a complete list. Change an entry only from the official page, and update its checked date (docs/county-coverage.md).

programs.title: Art and Culture Grant (2027-2029)
programs.objectives: General operating support over three years for art and culture organizations.
programs.who: 501(c)(3) or fiscally sponsored organizations in Philadelphia with average budgets up to $1.5 million.
programs.application: Apply through the fund's grants page.
programs.deadlines: Applications opened November 4, 2026 and are due December 18, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. ET.

programs.title: Community Impact Grant (2027-2029)
programs.agency: Philadelphia Cultural Fund (funded by the William Penn Foundation)
programs.objectives: Added unrestricted support for smaller Art and Culture grantees.
programs.who: Art and Culture grantees with average budgets up to $500,000.
programs.application: Apply through the fund's grants page.
programs.deadlines: Applications opened November 4, 2026 and are due December 18, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. ET.
